reviews.comment:
Fui a cargar el viernes a la madrugada , mala atención de una empleada , se molesto,  x q le pague con billetes de 500 , siendo q se los di bien acomodados , y varias veces tuvieron gestos descorteses,  yo q viajo x varias provincias,  y comparo , y la verdad son poco amables!

(Translated by Google)
I went to top up my phone early Friday morning. The service from one of the employees was terrible; she got annoyed because I paid with 500-peso bills, even though I gave them to her neatly arranged. She was rude several times. I travel to several provinces and compare prices, and honestly, they're not very friendly!

reviewReply.comment: Buenas tardes, luis se le tomará las medidas correspondientes para que no vuelva a suceder dicha situación. Disculpe por dicha situación y que tenga un buen día.
